newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high on slight gain.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high on slight gain.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at record highs on Monday after a small gain, supported by a rise in telecoms group Ericsson.
Shares were, however, pulled off intra-day highs by New York opening lower and by a drop in index heavyweight Astra.
The general index ticked up 0.04 percent to 2,478.95, a record high in turnover of 5.76 billion crowns.
"There is some nervousness ahead of Greenspan's speech in the U.S. senate tomorrow," a chief trader said.
Ericsson rose 4.5 crowns to 241 on positive sector trends, while Astra dropped 10 crowns to 320.5 crowns.
Astra was downgraded by Goldman Sachs to "market performer" from "market outperformer" and fell further when its U.S. counterparts opened lower.
Competitor Pharmacia & Upjohn dropped 11 to 273 crowns after its chief executive John Zabriskie resigned.
Goldman Sachs also cut engineering group Atlas Copco to "market performer" from "market outperformer" and the share slipped 0.5 crown to 168.5 crowns.
Miner Trelleborg rose two crowns to 110.5 crowns after its mining subsidiary Boliden announced a joint venture with South Atlantic Resources. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1006
